1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Astronomical Book (1 Enoch 72-82) (c. 250 BC)

'And now, my son Methuselah, all these things I am recounting to thee and writing down for thee, and I have revealed to thee everything, and given thee books concerning all these: so preserve, my son Methuselah, the books from thy father's hand, and see that thou deliver them to the generations of the world' — the textual transmission charge to Methuselah. Tewahedo monastic-scribal tradition treats this verse as the FOUNDATIONAL warrant for the entire Mäṣḥafä Hēnok preservation enterprise: the Ethiopian scribes who copied Enoch from the 4th century onward stood consciously in this Methuselan succession.
candidates.reviewer_notes: Curated PD interpretive summary representing the Ethiopian Tewahedo tradition's reading via 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition), Astronomical Book (1 Enoch 72-82). Verify the summary still reflects the source's argument before promoting; substitute a verbatim quote from the NPNF / Charles dump where available, and where applicable cross-check the Andəmta homiletic tradition for resonance.
